reviews.text: It has a nice jelly-like texture, but I wouldn't recommend it for oily skin as it absorbs very slowly.
reviews.zh: 質地好似啫喱咁，好好，但係我唔會推薦畀油性皮膚，因為吸收得好慢。

reviews.text: i’ve repurchased this about four times, i love it so much, after i shave my face or when i'm feeling irritated i put this on and feel better instantly, it makes my skin feel super moisturized and soft.
reviews.zh: 我已經回購咗大約四次，好鍾意。每次剃完面或者皮膚覺得唔舒服嗰陣，塗上去就即刻好返，令皮膚感覺非常滋潤、柔軟。

reviews.text: I really love this product. The quality is consistently great, and it has become one of my favorites. I'm already restocking because it's so useful, and I will definitely purchase it again in the future
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款產品。質素一直都好好，已經成為我最愛嘅其中一款。因為好實用，我已經再次補貨，將來一定會再買。

reviews.text: I got this for my daughter and she absolutely loves it. Makes her skin feel super hydrated and less irritated. I have tried this too on more mature skin and agree it made my skin more hydrated and gave it more bounce. Definitely will be repurchasing and not just for my daughter but for myself too
reviews.zh: 我係買畀我女兒嘅，佢好鍾意。令佢皮膚感覺超水潤，又冇咁易刺激。我亦試過喺較成熟嘅皮膚上用，同意佢令我皮膚更加水潤、更有彈力。一定會回購，唔係淨係畀女兒，我自己都會用。

reviews.text: I use this as a sleeping mask. I use this every other night during summer months when it's hot and humid. But plan to use every night during the dry winter months. I have gifted this to almost all my close family and friends - should tell you how much I love this product!
reviews.zh: 我用呢款做夜間面膜。夏天又熱又潮濕嗰陣，我隔晚用一次。但係乾燥嘅冬天，我計劃每晚都用。我幾乎將呢款送畀所有親近嘅家人同朋友，咁就知道我有幾鍾意呢款產品啦！

reviews.text: Got all 4 serums to try! I love that it's thick and moisturising, but because of that I usually use it at night instead. Haven't seen any visible results for the red smoothie serum yet but will continue using!
reviews.zh: 我買咗全部4款精華嚟試！我好鍾意佢質地厚身同保濕，不過正因為咁，我通常都係晚上用。紅色 smoothie 精華暫時未見到明顯效果，但我會繼續用！

reviews.text: Nice gel texture serum! I haven't noticed any results based on their claims but I do find it to be very moisturizing. One thing to note is that the product stays very sticky/thick on the skin so I definitely only recommend for nighttime use. Might be too heavy a product for those with oily skin. Takes a while to absorb/dry down but this is nice for using with my medicube booster device!
reviews.zh: 好有啫喱質地嘅精華！我未見到佢宣傳嗰啲效果，但係我覺得佢好保濕。要留意嘅係，產品留喺皮膚上好黏、好厚身，所以我絕對只會推薦晚上用。對於油性皮膚嘅人，可能太厚重。吸收同乾透都要一段時間，不過用嚟配合我嘅 medicube booster 儀器都幾好！

reviews.text: This serum is good for night use though i have not seen much change in my pores or skin texture but yes when i wake in morning my skin feels hydrated and fresh no dullness thought it is bit sticky i felt when i sleep
reviews.zh: 呢款精華晚上用幾好。雖然我未見到毛孔或者膚質有太大改變，但係朝早醒嚟嗰陣，皮膚感覺水潤、清新，冇暗啞感，不過瞓覺嗰陣我覺得有少少黏。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
